svg.text: The Intent Lease Contract: Spatial Tolerance Manifold & Temporal Expiration Timelines
Synthesized from Chi-Square Error Analysis, ISO 10218-1 Drivetrain Braking, and Gray (1989)

g.text: • Diagonal sensor variances: σ_x = 4.0 mm, σ_y = 6.0 mm, σ_z = 15.0 mm
• Semi-axes: a_i = √(χ²) · σ_i ⇒ a_x = 11.18 mm, a_y = 16.77 mm, a_z = 41.93 mm
• 95% Confidence Volume: V = 4/3 π a_x a_y a_z = 3.29 × 10⁻⁵ m³ (32.9 cm³)
• Spatial Fault Rule: Scene drift displacing object past boundary revokes lease.
Spatial Precision Asymmetry: Why Ellipsoids Beat Points
A motion planner receiving only the point p₀ attempts a precision grasp and collides with component
edges because depth uncertainty (41.9 mm) exceeds physical gripper capture clearance (12.0 mm).
Receiving the oriented ellipsoid allows the planner to align its approach vector with the narrow axis.
PANEL B: MULTI-RATE TEMPORAL EXPIRATION TIMELINES
CASE 1: NOMINAL CONTINUOUS LEASE RENEWAL (10 Hz REASONER STREAM)
Continuous C² Quintic Spline Tracking · Zero Deceleration Penalty
Renewals arrive every T_period = 100 ms < τ_ttl = 150 ms (Hardware Watchdog Reset Each Cycle)
CASE 2: SILENT HOST REASONER HANG & AUTONOMOUS MCU DECELERATION
